correctness.rationale: The complete rational character follows from the established top-dimensional wedge theorem, a direct equivariant bijection from commutation classes to acyclic orientations of induced cycle subgraphs, explicit orientation signs in the augmented cellular Lefschetz formula, and independently derived cyclic/linear transfer matrices. The rotations use gcd-periodic vertex subsets and exclude precisely the two coherent directed cycles; reflection foldings enforce the inverted-edge boundary conditions. The 66 element traces for n=3..8 were checked directly using integral cellular chains; chain equations and rank checks supply independent finite corroboration, not a proof of the infinite family.

originality.rationale: Full texts and relevant theorem statements of the original 2007 commutation-class, 2008 Boolean-complex and 2010 homology-basis papers were checked. They determine cell definitions, shellability, wedge type, Lucas number and mod-two homology bases, but do not state or imply the explicit signed all-element dihedral character or reflection-axis split. The quotient-rank formula is a consequence of this new character rather than an independent new result. Indexed search results on graph-complex dihedral actions and unrelated Boolean rank-span complexes do not imply this claim. Priority remains provisional against unindexed formulations.
residual_risks: Unindexed historical representation formulas or an equivalent description in Coxeter-complex literature could overlap the result.

value.rationale: This is an infinite, natural topological representation classification for the affine type A Coxeter-graph family. It distinguishes rotations by gcd and the two reflection-axis conjugacy classes when n is even, including negative character values, and computes all rational quotient top Betti numbers. Neither the ordinary sphere count nor homology freeness determines these equivariant data, so it answers a nontrivial structural gap rather than a relabeling or arbitrary finite slice.
